retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: a robbery of the Banco Totta & Açores at Malveira on 6 October 1980, the same day and the same village as the item above and possibly the same raid. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left. The PRP-BR, the FP-25 and the trials are all missing from it. An action of theirs has nothing to attach to in either direction, so any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: Robbery of the Totta & Açores Bank in Malveira, on 6 October 1980
summary: Wikidata item Q115636352, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Robbery carried out by the Popular Forces of 25 April, yielding 2,854,822 escudos, during which three people were killed". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
